dedupe_keys.name: open transport registers of the croatian ministry of the sea transport and infrastructure on data gov hr

description: The Croatian Ministry of the Sea, Transport and Infrastructure publishes 12 open datasets on the national open data portal, all under the Croatian open licence (Otvorena dozvola). Those read through the portal include the list of port authorities, updated in May 2026; the list of aerodrome operators holding a certificate and approval for use under the Air Transport Act and Commission Regulation (EU) 139/2014; the list of ports where port pilotage is compulsory; the list of authorised maritime pilotage companies; the timetables of intercounty and international bus lines in Croatia; the open data of the national register of road haulage operators; and lists of authorised centres and institutions for driver qualification and for training in the road transport of dangerous goods. The portal lists formats as CSV and XLSX, updated monthly or yearly. Access is free under the open licence. Caveats: the datasets are registers and lists, not network or asset data, several are about training bodies, and the ministry's own open data page was being updated when read. Coverage is Croatia. It supports network and capacity planning for ports, airports and road passenger transport, such as mapping licensed operators and bus line coverage; the related record is the Croatia disaster risk assessment 2019.
